10.text: The bow-drill was an instrument much used before the appearance of iron

11.text: to make holes in shafts for fastening spear-points, etc. To cut in two a piece

12.text: of ivory or hard wood, a number of holes were drilled side by side in a straight

13.text: line. Curiously enough, this method is still used by civilized peoples for dividing

14.text: steel armor-plate. The reason is evidently the same as with the primitive

15.text: man, — a lack of other tools adapted to cutting through the solid material.
